normal.name: Heart of a Lion Games
normal.text: We're a family studio making loud, silly co-op games for 2 to 6 friends. First up: Space Plumbers, about plumbing. In space. Also on the way: CatKraft, a cozy farming game where you play a cat. https://heartofalion.games/?utm_source=bluesky&utm_medium=social

normal.name: Vivian, Starlit Succubus
normal.text: ...Yes and no? Because I mostly play Stardew multiplayer, my job is to run the farm. So.. Um.. The notes are mostly... "Things we need for Community Center" or "The spreadsheet of how valuable all crops really are"

normal.name: Klara commits to the cause
normal.text: It's like an established relationship sim, I guess? I dunno how much depth it has, and people have brought up that older Rockstar games have these little real-life moments here and there that ultimately don't add up to much, but I guess we'll see what people think when they've been playing longer?

normal.name: Sammy ⏾
normal.text: I picked the Standard Farm for my new Stardew save because it's been ages since I last played on it, but I'm starting to have second thoughts 😅 Maybe I should start over and choose a different map after all?

normal.name: Himbology
normal.text: I dunno, I like to be even comfier during games… How about yes, but only if we don’t wear any clothes and we have big cozy blankets to wear instead while we game?

normal.name: a WEEN 🎃🦇🌕🧹
normal.text: Thisss. There's nothing wrong with these games, or marketing to women, but where are the Cozy Games where you collect sports jerseys for your avatar or chop wood as a 3merge "puzzle"? It doesn't add up unless this is an intentional concept of the genre.
